name: Programmable Transfer Function DVR
aliases: Base Direct Volume Rendering with Programmable Transfer Functions
definition: A volume rendering technique that replaces traditional texture-based transfer function lookups with a function call at every sample location to compute color and opacity, trading memory fetches for computation to allow real-time parameter modification.
summary: Programmable Transfer Function DVR is a ray casting technique that computes optical properties via programmable functions instead of texture lookups, enabling real-time parameter modification and reducing data transfer bottlenecks.
